description: CoinLoader/BotAppStore: Buy a bot license. By default (confirm=false) it only previews the price and creates nothing; call again with confirm=true only after the user agrees to buy. method=card with confirm=true creates a Stripe checkout session and returns a checkout_url for a human to pay (BotAppStore and CoinLoader). method=sol never creates an order: it returns a price preview and the bot page where a human completes SOL checkout (CoinLoader and wattcoin.org bots only; BotAppStore is card only). Use list_products first to get the SKU. Returns JSON.

confirm.description: Default false = price preview, nothing created. true = create the card checkout session or SOL hand-off

method.description: Payment method: card (default; not allowed for site=wattcoin) or sol (preview only)

site.description: Store: botappstore, coinloader, or wattcoin (wattcoin.org bots, SOL only). Defaults to botappstore

sku.description: Product or bundle SKU from list_products (e.g. mill-cert-matcher)

storefront.description: Alias of site for botappstore or coinloader; site wins if both are given

name: start_checkout
title: CoinLoader/BotAppStore: Start checkout
